experienceChange.evidenceBoundary: The redesign changes explanation, hierarchy, navigation and progressive disclosure. It does not reduce controls or claim independent usability research, accessibility certification or improved conversion.

focusedExperienceAndSecurityGate.command: NODE_ENV=test node --test tests/access-control.test.js tests/runtime-policy.test.js tests/control-plane.test.js tests/customer-journey.test.js tests/experience-design.test.js

detectionBenchmark.scope: Small internal synthetic English regression set; not independent or production-representative.

limitations: The automated gate used isolated local test persistence and did not connect to production PostgreSQL, Stripe, Resend or Render services.
No production deployment, live payment, production email or production customer-data action was performed in this environment.
Automated screenshot rendering was unavailable because local browser navigation was blocked by administrator policy.
Source-level responsive and accessibility checks do not replace manual keyboard, screen-reader, zoom, browser and physical-device testing.
The audit is internal engineering evidence, not independent usability research, accessibility certification, penetration testing or proof of conversion improvement.
This proprietary assessment is not an accredited certification or a guarantee that the system is risk-free.
liveVerificationRequired: Verify /api/ready reports version 10.0.0, production stage, healthy PostgreSQL and migration 008 current.
Review the public homepage, start, pricing, trust, help, demo and sign-in journeys on desktop and mobile.
Verify an ordinary customer sees one recommended action after sign-in and can complete the safe protection check without a terminal.
Verify advanced policy, key, approval, inventory, remediation, retest and audit workflows remain available to authorised roles.
Test keyboard navigation, focus order, menu Escape behaviour, zoom, reduced motion and representative screen readers.
Review privacy-respecting journey analytics and support signals before claiming improved usability or conversion.
Review logs, alerts and rollback readiness before recording a deployment decision.
